info.title: Mountweave API
info.description: Composable file, mount-control and generic task HTTP delivery. Synchronous file operations and file tasks use the same typed request and Core semantics. The host injects identity policy, driver factories, durable storage and optional task kinds. Advertised operations are not per-mount capability or authorization grants. Optional durable inputs resume client byte receipt; sealed inputs feed the same Core.Write semantics synchronously or through process-local tasks.

servers.description: Example contract address only. The host owns listeners, transport settings and shutdown.

tags.name: files
tags.description: Authorized file access and effect-preserving mutations.

tags.name: control
tags.description: Optional desired definitions and explicit runtime activation; independent management authority.

tags.description: Optional bounded process-local task delivery with host-defined wire adapters and access policy.

tags.name: inputs
tags.description: Optional durable input bytes and immutable source versions. Ownership policy is independent of file and task authorization.

get.summary: Get API information and admission limits
get.description: Authentication is required. Products, accounts, and configuration are not listed. Unknown or duplicate single-value query parameters return 400.

200.description: The first headless read contract.

get.description: Ordinary resource checks precede preconditions. Ambiguity returns 409. Unknown time or length is null. Native references, physical paths, and credentials are not exposed.

200.description: Currently observed metadata; it does not establish a later content snapshot.

delete.description: Requires remove authorization. A directory must be empty; a final symbolic link is removed itself. No body or conditional/range headers. Absence is a 404 unchanged result. No recursive fallback, recycle bin, or identity-stable conditional deletion.

200.description: The complete target effect is confirmed. This does not promise power-loss durability or atomic complete-before-visible publication.

get.summary: Enumerate a directory within bounded resources
get.description: Native enumeration order; no total, global sort, or snapshot guarantee. An empty items array is not EOF; only next_cursor=null is EOF. The latest page is replayable until the next cursor is used. Invalid or expired cursors return 410. Non-EOF failures do not return a successful partial page. Preconditions are evaluated before advancing the enumeration. Short pages can retain continuation. cursor_expires_at reports the actual selected expiry; this API fixes no deployment cursor capacity, TTL, or byte budget. Resource completion is distinct from expiry or cancellation.

200.description: At most limit entries and an ephemeral cursor; native provider tokens are not exposed.

get.description: Return bytes without exposing provider URLs or buffering the whole file. The default is a complete 200 response; a reliable single range can return 206. Display timestamps are not converted into strong ETags. This API mandates no numeric open, idle, or transfer deadline. If a caller or host applies an open-phase timer, successful adoption stops that timer without canceling the context that owns the body.

200.description: Complete content, including when Range is ignored. Clients must not append it as a 206 fragment. Failure after successful headers aborts the transfer without appending Problem JSON or recording complete success.

Content-Length.description: Use only a trustworthy length for this opened response. Omit it when unknown. HEAD uses current metadata and does not download the body to calculate length.

Accept-Ranges.description: Declare only admitted, reliable range support. Use none when unavailable or unknown.

put.summary: Write raw bytes, with explicit complete-file replacement
put.description: Default creation preserves the existing create-only contract and requires create authority. replace=true requires write authority and FilePublisher: receive complete input before publishing, create if absent. It is independent of tree-directory merge. Input failure leaves an existing target unchanged in replacement mode. Combining replacement with If-None-Match is invalid. Only true/false are accepted when replace is supplied. No append, native version precondition, durability or automatic replay guarantee is added. Content-Length remains an exact whole-input length; unknown length is accepted by supported modes. The body is streamed under request lifetime, not buffered into a task request.

201.description: The complete target effect is confirmed. This does not promise power-loss durability or atomic complete-before-visible publication.

requestBody.description: Raw file bytes. Empty input creates an empty file; bytes are not decoded or converted.

post.description: Requires create authorization on the target and an existing real parent. Does not create ancestors or change virtual directories or mount roots. No request body or conditional/range headers are accepted. Unsupported mounts return 501 before target effects.

201.description: The complete target effect is confirmed. This does not promise power-loss durability or atomic complete-before-visible publication.

post.summary: Accept a typed task independently of the HTTP request
post.description: Requires task submit authority; file execution reauthorizes through Core. Reserve HTTP result capacity before Prepare/queue admission. On successful acceptance the task owns its context. Location identifies the retained record. Active records are not evicted; completed records evict oldest accepted first when new admission needs space. Unknown/evicted IDs return 404. Failed rejection cleanup retains ownership and blocks further task admission; adapter Close reports it. Host owns queue, persistence and record budget.

HostBearer.description: A host-injected verifier maps an opaque Bearer credential to a principal. It does not prescribe file, environment, or database sources. There is no issuance endpoint, query token, cookie, or guest fallback.

Path.name: path
Path.description: Absolute strict virtual path, decoded once. Root is /. Other paths have no trailing slash, empty segment, dot segment, backslash, or control character. Names match exactly without Unicode normalization or case folding. At most 4096 UTF-8 bytes and 64 segments; maxLength does not replace the byte check.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: On the first page, omission means 100; the range is 1 through 200. Continuations inherit the cursor limit when omitted. Supplying a different limit returns 410 cursor_unavailable.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Ephemeral process-local continuation handle bound to directory, principal, scope, generation, and limit. Only the latest page is replayable before advancing. It is not a durable object ID.

Range.name: Range
Range.description: GET accepts one valid bytes range. Ignore multiple ranges, unknown units, or unreliable range support and return full 200. Invalid recognized bytes syntax returns 400. HEAD ignores Range. If-Range without a matching strong validator also causes full 200.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: No ETag is emitted in the current API. For an existing resource, * passes; other valid tags have no current match and return 412. Ordinary resource errors take precedence.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: No ETag is emitted in the current API. For an existing resource, * returns 304 for GET or HEAD; other valid tags do not match.

IfModifiedSince.name: If-Modified-Since
IfModifiedSince.description: Ignore this date condition because the current API has no reliable Last-Modified validator.

IfUnmodifiedSince.name: If-Unmodified-Since
IfUnmodifiedSince.description: Ignore this date condition because the current API has no reliable Last-Modified validator.

IfRange.name: If-Range
IfRange.description: The current API has no matching strong validator. Ignore Range and return full 200 when Range is present; otherwise ignore If-Range.

CreateIfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
CreateIfNoneMatch.description: Optional create-only condition. Checked by the native exclusive creation, never by Stat-then-write. Existing targets return 412 with unchanged; without this header they return 409. Other mutation conditions and range headers are rejected before effects.

InvalidRequest.description: Invalid path, query parameter, duplicate single-value parameter, or Range syntax.

Unauthenticated.description: Only the API caller credential is missing or invalid; there is no guest fallback.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge without the supplied credential.

NotFound.description: The target was confirmed absent; upstream failures are not reported as missing.

Conflict.description: Ambiguous target, wrong target type, or an unrepresentable name.

CursorUnavailable.description: The cursor is unknown, expired, invalidated, outside its replay window, or bound to another context.

RangeNotSatisfiable.description: A valid byte range cannot be satisfied.

Content-Range.description: Return bytes */N only when the total length is trustworthy.

CapacityExceeded.description: The bounded instance admission capacity is exhausted.

Retry-After.description: Return only when a retry time is actually known; clients must not retry blindly.

UpstreamFailure.description: Upstream failure, refusal, or invalid response; this is not the API caller 401.

Unavailable.description: Mount unavailable, resolution or response budget exhausted, or upstream throttled.

Retry-After.description: Return only when a retry time is actually known; clients must not retry blindly.

NotModified.description: A conditional GET or HEAD sends no body. The current API has no ETag or Last-Modified validator; If-None-Match:* matches an existing resource.

MutationFailure.description: Mutation failed; the effect describes this call and may still be applied, incomplete, or unknown. Response diagnostics are redacted. Parser rejection before this handler or a disconnected client need not receive this body.

MutationUnauthenticated.description: Caller authentication failed before any target effect.

operations.description: Operations offered by the server, not per-mount capability or authorization grants.

file_operations_read_only.description: The server exposes optional mutation operations; individual mounts may remain read-only.

input_journal_max_bytes.description: Host-selected input limit; zero when the input component is absent.

input_append_max_bytes.description: Host-selected input limit; zero when the input component is absent.

input_records_max.description: Host-selected input limit; zero when the input component is absent.

input_blocks_max.description: Host-selected retained/reserved block-index limit; zero when input storage is absent.

limits.description: Host-selected task record bound and JSON input limit, with zero meaning component absent/no extra JSON limit; existing Core path/page limits remain unchanged. Raw file content uses Core/Driver and host transport budgets.

name.description: Root has an empty name; other entries retain the exact stored name without automatic renaming.

size.description: Known file length in bytes. Unknown values and directories are null; directory totals are not fabricated.

modified_at.description: A display observation, not a strong HTTP validator.

detail.description: Redacted diagnostic information. Never echo the input token, physical path, DSN, signed URL, or provider secret.

result.description: Known structured effects or activation facts retained when the operation also fails.

Effect.description: Target effects of this call, independent of its error. No absence of effects is inferred from cancellation or transport failure.

MutationProblem.description: A failed mutation with its target effect preserved. Applied may accompany an error; do not automatically retry. A missing response leaves the client uncertain.

concurrency.description: Zero and one select Core serial execution. This is per-call W, separate from queue concurrency J.
Zero and one select Core serial execution. This is per-call W, separate from queue concurrency J.

max_entries.description: Bounds client discovery/planning, not the number of descendants affected by native subtree deletion.

max_plan_bytes.description: Bounds stored client plan path/key bytes; native subtree deletion need not enumerate descendants.

scope.description: Empty/omitted selects discovered and preserves the finite-name plan. Subtree requires remove_tree authority for descendant deletion; new descendants may be affected and native execution may return only a root receipt.

FileOperationRequest.description: One typed file request, used unchanged for synchronous execution or queued delivery. Input syntax and all selected real bindings are admitted before execution. Execution retains Core stop, attempted-prefix, cancellation, link and partial-effect contracts. Copy defaults to new-file conflict; tree merge and per-file replacement are independent. Move is native same-mount relocation only. RemoveTree uses execution-time name intent. Structured mutations reject conditional/range headers; no automatic retries or rollback.

TaskRequest.description: Host kinds decode their own input and project redacted results. Registration extends this HTTP adapter, not the generic scheduler. Input is structured JSON, not serialized executable code or a borrowed request body.

cleanup_error.description: Cleanup failure retains the known file effect.

FileResult.description: Single target effect, two Move endpoint effects, or ordered attempted item receipts. Empty item lists are omitted. Duplicate batch inputs remain distinct. Applied/unknown/partial effects remain meaningful on error; unstarted suffix items are absent.

Definition.description: Desired input, independent of activation. Lists and save confirmations omit config and secret references. Individual reads omit native config unless the host explicitly supplies a safe projection.

SaveDefinition.description: Full desired input for the next explicit Apply/Restore. expected_revision zero creates; other values must match atomically. Omitted enabled is false. Native config is factory-owned, secrets are host references. Save does not replace the running instance.

Activation.description: Observed activation facts, without native pointers or raw errors. requested_revision is selected by Apply; revision is last installed/disabled. A root can be active when aliases fail. Retirement timeout is not cleanup acknowledgement.

TaskView.description: A successful GET observes a task, even when the task failed. Finished is not a success or absence-of-effects claim. Execution, cleanup and completion-save errors are separate stable codes; task kind owns safe progress/result projection. Published values are immutable.

version.description: Immutable journal/content version identity, not a whole-file content hash.

InputRecord.description: Offset is a confirmed contiguous payload prefix, not target publication. Release blocks new references; accepted work and opened bodies retain bytes until cleanup. Blocked inputs need storage reconciliation.

WriteInput.description: Pins a sealed input at admission, opens it at execution, and invokes Core.Write with the same file authorization, binding and effects as streamed PUT. Queue lifetime and input lifetime remain separate.

x-method-policy: Undefined methods return 405 with Allow. PUT and other writes are not declared implemented.
x-query-policy: Unknown or duplicate single-value query parameters return 400. Do not decode URL syntax twice.
x-transport-rejections: Malformed HTTP, header read timeout, and oversized headers can be rejected by the HTTP parser before an API handler runs. Those transport responses can use plain text or close the connection; application errors after admission use Problem Details.
